facts.label: I wonder + who/why/what
facts.sub: Use I wonder + who / why / what / when / how + sujeito + verbo. A ordem é normal: who lives there, why it is closed. Não use does.

facts.label: fico curioso sobre quem
facts.sub: Use I wonder who lives there para expressar curiosidade. Depois de who, use o verbo no presente: lives. Não use does nem a ordem de pergunta.

facts.label: por que, o que, quando
facts.sub: I wonder why it is closed. I wonder what is inside. I wonder when he comes back. A ordem é sempre normal: sujeito e verbo.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: I wonder who lives there is correct.
We say “I wonder who does live there.”
Wonder means to want to know.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: I wonder who lives there is correct. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “I wonder who does live there.” → Falso (We say who lives there.)
Wonder means to want to know. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: A curious walk · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a quiet, rainy morning in Portland. Frank and Sara walk along a street with tall trees. Water drips from the green leaves. They stop in front of an old blue house. Nobody is in the garden today. Frank looks up at the windows and wonders.

“Look at that old blue house. I wonder who lives there.” says Frank. “I wonder too. It always has beautiful flowers in the garden.” says Sara. “I wonder why the windows are always closed.” says Frank.
